description: Where a single team sits in each ranking MaxPreps publishes for it — typically national, state, state division/class, and metro area — along with the teams ranked immediately around it. Use this for "how good is this team"; use maxpreps_get_rankings to browse a whole leaderboard. Read-only.

season.description: Season label, e.g. 25-26. Omit for the current season.

team.description: Team site path or URL, e.g. nc/charlotte/myers-park-mustangs/football

name: maxpreps_get_team_rankings
title: Get one team’s rankings
